observations: Some university names render cut off: "Sabaragamuwa University of", "Uva Wellassa University of", "Rajarata University of", "Wayamba University of" (courses list, course detail, My list, Compare). Looks like a data/name-trimming issue, not covered by a case.
Grammar: "1 courses within reach match \"data\"" (singular not handled).

Automation note: agent-browser "find role/text ... click" missed 3 times (Create account, Log in link, Groups nav link) while the same controls worked with snapshot refs or requestSubmit. Treated as tool flakiness, retried once each; not app defects.

Group joins were only on existing groups (Computer Science 9 members, Medicine 5 members). No chat messages posted, no Ask questions sent. The Medicine group was exited in the test; the Computer Science membership was left for the account delete to remove (not re-checked in the UI afterwards).
Reminder time was left at 6 pm on the deleted account (stored on the device only).
